title: Canonical module base-change iso comparison
statement: Choose the shared derived categories and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to S'$ form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $c:Lg'^*(G[0])\to(g'^*G)[0]$ satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. For arbitrary scheme isomorphisms $e_S:S\cong A$, $e_T:S'\cong B$, set $f_A=f\mathbin{\gg}e_S$, $g_A=e_T^{-1}\mathbin{\gg}g\mathbin{\gg}e_S$, $P=X\times_A B$, $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to B$, and $T=R(e_T^{-1})_*$. There exist $c_0:Lp^*(G[0])\to(p^*G)[0]$ satisfying IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison, isomorphisms $a:Lg^*Rf_*(G[0])\cong T(Lg_A^*Rf_{A,*}(G[0]))$ and $b:Rf'_*(g'^*G)[0]\cong T(Rq_*((p^*G)[0]))$, such that $(\beta\mathbin{\gg}Rf'_*(c))\mathbin{\gg}b=a\mathbin{\gg}T(\beta_A\mathbin{\gg}Rq_*(c_0))$. Here $\beta$ and $\beta_A$ are the canonical derived mates [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No open restriction or affine hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: The isomorphisms eS and eT identify the original cartesian square with the chosen pullback of f followed by eS.hom and eT.inv followed by g and eS.hom. The unique pullback isomorphism preserves the first projection and takes the second projection, followed by eT.inv, to f'.

Pullback along a scheme isomorphism is an exact equivalence on modules. Its derived functor is the induced equivalence on derived categories. Direct image along the inverse is its inverse equivalence. Apply composition of derived pullbacks and direct images and the inverse-coordinate identities to obtain a. Use the pullback isomorphism and tensor-pullback composition to identify the ordinary pulled-back modules; derive this identification and then apply direct image composition to obtain b.

Transport the witnessing counit in hc through the pullback isomorphism. Composition with exact equivalences preserves its left-derived universal property. Evaluating on G[0] and inserting the ordinary tensor-pullback identification gives c0 with the required comparison predicate.

Transpose both base-change mates under the adjunction for the second projection. The pullback composition comparisons identify their transposes: both are pullback of the same counit of f, with inverse coordinates cancelled. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence gives the equality of mates. Naturality then composes with the transported module counit from step 3, giving the displayed square. This also applies to empty schemes and zero modules.

theorem exists_canonicalModuleBaseChange_iso_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (G : X.Modules)
    (c : (derivedPullback g').obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison g' G c)
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} (eS : S ≅ A) (eT : S' ≅ B) :
    let fA := f ≫ eS.hom
    let gA := eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom
    let E := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G
    let T := schemeDerivedDirectImage eT.inv
    ∃ c0 : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj E ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj G),
      IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison (pullback.fst fA gA) G c0 ∧
      ∃ a : (derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ≅
          T.obj ((derivedPullback gA).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage fA).obj E)),
      ∃ b : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G)) ≅
          T.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj G))),
        (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w E ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map c) ≫ b.hom =
          a.hom ≫ T.map
            (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap fA (pullback.snd fA gA) gA (pullback.fst fA gA)
              pullback.condition E ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).map c0)
